channel.title: Gruvi publishing guides
channel.description: Social publishing APIs, MCP, scheduling and analytics.

item.title: A social media API for AI agents: from upload to verified delivery
item.description: How to connect an agent to Gruvi, upload finished media, choose exact account targets and check whether a post actually published.

item.title: Bulk video scheduling: plan a batch without duplicating posts
item.description: Schedule up to 20 finished videos through the Gruvi dashboard, API or MCP connector, with individual times and retry-safe results.

item.title: Instagram and TikTok carousels: upload, order and schedule your images
item.description: Prepare 2 to 10 images for Instagram, TikTok or a Facebook Page, then publish now or choose a future time.

item.title: A practical guide to social media analytics across five platforms
item.description: Understand Gruvi analytics for TikTok and YouTube, engagement summaries for Instagram, Facebook and X, and how to handle missing metrics.

item.title: Connect Claude Code or Codex to your social publishing workflow
item.description: Install Gruvi's local MCP server, store your key safely and verify account access before asking an agent to upload or schedule content.

item.title: How to retry a social publishing request without creating duplicates
item.description: Use stable request IDs, inspect delivery after uncertainty and distinguish a scheduled post, a TikTok draft and a confirmed publication.
